title: Clopen scalar quotient comparisons form a natural strict tower isomorphism
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme T, a clopen U, and normalized coefficient restriction data d of [def-sf-clopen-restriction-data]. The unrestricted completed-integral quotient tower of [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], followed termwise by sfClopenComplexRestriction(d), is naturally isomorphic to sfClopenComplexRestriction(d) followed by the unrestricted quotient tower on U. The isomorphism is natural on all unbounded input complexes and commutes with every strict transition, without completeness or constructibility assumptions.

source.place: lemma-pullback-module (Tag 03D2), lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules (Tag 03D7), lemma-push-pull-composition-modules (Tag 03D8), lemma-tensor-product-pullback (Tag 03EL); sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 06YY. Step 1 of lem-fix-clopen-integral-completion-restriction.

proof.text: Take the actual quotient isomorphisms from sf_clopen_scalar_quotient_comparison. To prove transition compatibility and naturality in the complex, precompose with the inverse quotient comparison and apply the sheafified tensor-generator extensionality theorem. Its inverse sends a local pure tensor to the corresponding ambient pure tensor by the supplied normalization. For transitions use d.transition and the normalized unrestrictedIntegralTransition formula; for naturality use the scalar-extension map formula. NatTrans.ofOpSequence and pointwise invertibility assemble a natural isomorphism of strict towers.

lean.statement:
theorem clopenScalarQuotientTower
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (U : T.Opens) (hU : IsClosed (U : Set T))
    (d : SfClopenCoefficientRestriction l E T U) :
    Nonempty ((Functor.ofOpSequence (unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E T)).flip ⋙
        (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ _ _).obj (sfClopenComplexRestriction d) ≅
      sfClopenComplexRestriction d ⋙
        (Functor.ofOpSequence (unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E U.toScheme)).flip)
